values.note: Book on Campspot or call (406) 212-7300; summer 2027 is open. Full payment at booking; changes or cancellations 14+ days before arrival get a 75% refund. The site type is guaranteed but not the site number unless you pay the $50 site lock. Check-in 1 PM, check-out 11 AM. One RV and one tow vehicle per site (extra vehicle $3/day).

note: Off MT-40 between Whitefish and Columbia Falls, 22 miles from Glacier NP; half secluded forest, half open ground with mountain views. Sites $65-90 a night per the park's site. --Claude
summary: Operator site + Campspot: confirmed reservable on Campspot and the Good Sam/military discounts (10%, now manual). Added season May 1 - Oct 1 (winter monthly only), 50-amp full hookups, pull-throughs, dump/laundry/WiFi, booking terms. Fees not written: the site's '$65-90' and Campspot's per-type averages ($73.60-$136.99) disagree and neither is dated. Note: Good Sam/season/Campspot/RV Life restatements dropped.
flags: Fees unresolved: wpinesrv.com/rv-sites says 'Sites range from $65-$90 per night' (on a page selling summer 2027), but Campspot's own site list shows 'Avg per night' from $73.60 (water & electric) to $99.60 (premium full hookup) and $136.99 (BigSky premium pull-through), the same on two 2027 dates with nothing available. Either way it is over US$50; the Glacier NP gateway (26.2 km, gateways.py) lifts the gate.
Long-stay check: October 1 - May 1 is monthly-only, and summer has 'limited monthly sites'; summer is nightly, so nights are for sale to a passing traveller for five months.
